messages.content: Write a monthly engineering update for a team of twelve, covering a migration, two hires, and a slipped deadline. Around 200 words.

**Engineering update — August**

The Postgres migration is finished. We moved the last two services off the old cluster on the 19th, ran a week of dual reads to be certain, then shut the old replicas down Friday. Latency improved a little. The bigger win is that nobody has to remember which cluster owns which table. Priya and Sam took most of the 6am cutover windows, which is worth saying out loud.

Two people joined this month. Dani is on platform and has already fixed a build flake that had been annoying us since spring. Marcus is on payments and is a few weeks into onboarding. If you have a small, self-contained bug in your area, send it their way.

The reporting rewrite slipped. We committed to end of August; realistically it lands mid-October. Nobody will be surprised by the cause. We underestimated how much logic lived in the old stored procedures, and we found it one query at a time instead of auditing up front. That is on me for not asking for a discovery week. September is scoped to the audit plus the three highest-traffic reports, and I would rather move the date once than move it monthly.

Questions in standup or my DMs.

Names, dates, and the specifics are placeholders — swap in yours.
